expectations.text: Recommends extracting the shared Avatar component (NOT keeping 12 inline copies)
expectations.evidence: 'Extract the shared <Avatar/>. The extract camp is right' and 'Bottom line: Extract it.'

expectations.text: Grounds it in the pure-presentation / understood-in-isolation test (low external context to consume)
expectations.evidence: 'It's a purely presentational unit: props in... markup out, no side effects... exactly the case the understood in isolation test is built to flag... An agent opening Avatar.tsx needs almost zero external context.'

expectations.text: Rejects the 'keep inline for self-containment' argument as misapplied to a reusable primitive
expectations.evidence: 'that argument applies to a specific failure mode: a split that leaves each file dependent on the others... Avatar is the opposite of that.' Inlining 'achieves the opposite' of self-containment.

expectations.text: Frames the shared component as a real abstraction (read at call site without opening internals), not just DRY
expectations.evidence: 'An agent opening a host component sees <Avatar.../> — a real abstraction with a name and an interface. It knows enough to proceed without reading the internals... prefer a real abstraction (named, interfaced, implementation hidden).'
